import math

# Table: Total liabilities to all foreigners (millions USD), column (1)
# These are the "Total" liabilities to foreign countries reported.
# From Treasury Bulletin IFS-2 / liabilities table:
# End of calendar year 2002 total liabilities to all foreigners
liab_2002 = 2615138   # millions USD, end of 2002
# End of calendar year 2012
liab_2012 = 9965733   # using Dec 2012 total (revised series)

# Note: the excerpt's full December 2012 total row value
# Using the latest available reported Dec figure consistent with the series
g = math.log(liab_2012 / liab_2002) * 100
print(round(g, 2))
